leaves.prompt_family: complete Casimir apparatus energy to ordinary weak-field gravity control

Solar coherence narratives stay hypothesis-scoped and subordinate to the measured Casimir to collapse benchmark family.

leaves.prompt_family: photospheric KHI to flux braiding and later nanoflare prediction
